default/30615.htm.text: Breka Chief Voltar: I, Breka tribe's great Chief, Voltar! The strength of our tribe is mighty! We will drive out those weak Humans and establish a new kingdom!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30615-01.html.text: Breka Chief Voltar: You impertinent novice! What makes you think you can just barge in here to see me, Voltar, Chief of the Breka? To be in my presence you need at least a signed letter from your tribe's Shaman ! Get out of my sight!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30615-02.html.text: Breka Chief Voltar: You! North Orc! Saucy brat! Why are you here?

links.text: I have come to collect the Oath of Loyalty and the Scepter of Flame!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30615-05.html.text: Breka Chief Voltar: Voltus! Pasica! Teach this novice a lesson!

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30615-03.html.text: Breka Chief Voltar: Ha! We declared our independence 500 years ago! Now you come here and tell me that I should pledge loyalty to the King? The days when we lived as an oppressed race are long over! Go and give your King this message: I would rather be the head of the snake than the tail of the dra…

links.text: "I will take the Royal Seal by force if you will not pledge loyalty to the King!"

Q00220_TestimonyOfGlory/30615-04.html.text: Breka Chief Voltar: Tejakar Oroka! Insolent fool! Voltus! Pashika! Teach this foolish kid a lesson worth remembering!
